title: Great figures he met said we are not alone

tellings.quote: You know these kinds of minds, the greatest minds, real geniuses, all of them said we are not alone.

plain: An official who led a republic within Russia, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that the greatest minds he met all told him we are not alone in the universe. He names people such as Pope John Paul II, the Dalai Lama, the Bulgarian seer Baba Vanga, the Indian guru Sai Baba, the American statesman Henry Kissinger and the Russian physicist Zhores Alferov. He tells it because, if true, some of the world's most respected figures privately believed other intelligences exist.
